core.title: Bumblebee Door Knocker, Michael Healy MH1101

text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1101, Brass Bumblebee Door Knocker

The Bumblebee Door Knocker is a stunning example of Michael Healy's artistic hardware. Its unique design is a great way to show your personality right on your front door. After all, first impressions are lasting impressions. The Brass Bee Door Knocker is made from sandcast brass and finished in polished brass. The attention to detail makes this premium front door knocker a real statement piece and shows that Michael Healy Designs make quality products that last. This 5 Inch Bee Knocker has 2-3/16 inch mounting centers and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also see other Michael Healy Door Knockers

Features and Specifications of the Bee Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish:Polished Brass
  • Height: 5"
  • Width: 4-1-2"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 2-3/16"
  • Projection Off Door: 2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
